title: GitHub Universe
metaDescription: GitHub Universe: verified dates, venue and practical planning context for this technology event.

overview.about: GitHub Universe is GitHub's annual developer conference in San Francisco, where the world's largest code-hosting platform sets out its vision for how software gets built. In recent years it has been dominated by AI-assisted development and the Copilot toolset.
overview.nextEvent: The next GitHub Universe is held in San Francisco and streamed globally. Keynotes and sessions focus on developer tools, open source and AI coding, aimed at the platform's tens of millions of developers.

@graph.name: GitHub Universe
@graph.description: GitHub Universe is GitHub’s annual product and developer conference, where the company uses keynotes and workshops to discuss the platform used for code hosting, collaboration and automation. The 2026 edition is scheduled at Fort Mason Center on San Francisco’s waterfront. Its in-person programme is complemented by virtual access, so the registration type determines whether a trip is necessary.
